description: How much GPU memory an AI model needs (LLMs such as Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, Gemma, GPT-OSS; image and video models such as FLUX, SDXL, Wan) at a given precision and context length, and which GPUs on gpu.nz fit it with their current price. Call without `model` to list the known models.

precision.description: Weights precision: "fp16", "fp8", "q8", "q6", "q5", "q4" (LLMs; default q4 for LLMs, fp16 for image models)

name: estimate_vram
title: Estimate VRAM for an AI model
